source_summary: The symbol ◌ represents any Khmer consonant or consonant plus foot; → means is romanized.
conditions_or_exceptions: Placeholder notation only; not a phonological rule.
limitations: Does not define syllable parsing or resolve ambiguous foot identity.

source_summary: MUUSIKATOAN ◌៊ changes an â-series consonant to ô-series; TRIISAP ◌៉ changes an ô-series consonant to â-series.
conditions_or_exceptions: MUUSIKATOAN exception for ប and បា; marks are frequently omitted, especially in words of Indic provenance.
limitations: Omitted marks cannot be reconstructed from spelling without lexical/reference evidence.

source_summary: A foot normally determines the following nucleus series; the base determines it when the foot is weak: nasals ង ញ ណ ន ម and យ រ ល វ. ប/បា with TRIISAP and ប/បា with a foot are romanized p in the â-series.
conditions_or_exceptions: Subscript glyphs can be ambiguous; PCGN says reference consultation may be needed. The weak-foot exception selects base series only when the base is not itself weak.
example_scope: Guide examples thmâ, pâng, plêng, p’â, prăb.
source_locator: Consonant table notes after table; Notes §3
limitations: Do not extend the weak list with ស; that is the UNGEGN 2013 delta. Do not infer a foot's underlying consonant when ambiguous.

source_summary: The â-series consonant អ is represented by an apostrophe.
conditions_or_exceptions: Word-initial apostrophe before a vowel letter is optional.
limitations: Orthographic marker; not an IPA glottal-stop annotation or a Ukrainian consonant.

source_summary: BANTOC ◌់ occurs in ◌◌់ and ◌ា◌់; SAMYOK SANNYA ◌័ occurs in ◌័◌. Both are ă in the â-series. In the ô-series both are eă before k/ng/h and oă otherwise.
conditions_or_exceptions: Exact mark placement and following coda condition are required; do not apply a generic shortening rule to arbitrary vowels.
example_scope: Guide examples bát, chăk, rôpeăk, moăt, veăngk, phoăpv.
limitations: No context-free output for either mark; parser must retain mark identity and coda.

source_summary: ROBAT ◌៌ is romanized rC, where C is any romanized Khmer consonant.
conditions_or_exceptions: Requires the following consonant's romanized value.
limitations: Cannot be mapped independently of the following consonant.

source_summary: ◌៏ is not romanized in syllable-initial position; in syllable-final position it indicates that the consonant is vowelled with â or ô according to series.
conditions_or_exceptions: Behavior depends on syllable position and consonant series.
example_scope: Guide examples sâ, sâsâs, tâmnâ, pômô.
limitations: Requires reliable syllable-position analysis; do not treat as a silent mark in all positions.

source_summary: ◌៍ appears above characters that are not pronounced and is not romanized.
conditions_or_exceptions: The marked character is not pronounced.
limitations: Source orthography must be retained separately from pronunciation; no Ukrainian target inferred.

source_summary: Independent vowel ឧ is romanized ŏ or ŭ.
conditions_or_exceptions: Consult a reference source when uncertain.
example_scope: Independent/Dependent Vowel Characters table row 7; Notes §9.
source_locator: Independent/Dependent Vowel Characters table row 7; Notes §9
limitations: Alternatives are not interchangeable and are not resolved by this note.

source_summary: The guide enumerates the Unicode code points for the romanization system's modified Latin letters, including precomposed and decomposed breve forms.
conditions_or_exceptions: Character inventory only; preserve canonical Unicode distinctions during normalization and storage.
limitations: Inventory is not a mapping rule; NFC handling must not erase meaningful distinctions.

source_summary: The tables show lowercase forms; uppercase and lowercase Roman letters should be used as appropriate when romanizing.
conditions_or_exceptions: Case follows the romanized text's orthographic context.
limitations: Does not define title casing or Ukrainian capitalization policy.
